indicesNarrative: Major US index futures are stabilizing in early trade with QQQ (+0.49%) outperforming SPY (+0.24%) and DIA (+0.06%). Tech leadership is staging a relief bid after yesterday's pullback, aided by a 2.2% drop in crude oil, though the 10-year Treasury yield's proximity to 5.00% keeps institutional participants cautious ahead of today's Federal Reserve interest rate decision.
technicalsNarrative: SPY and QQQ sit at FAIR entry risk holding above their 21-day EMAs, while DIA is testing its 21 EMA at AT-MA support. Momentum indicators are cooling broadly with SPY and QQQ MACD histograms negative and bear crossovers imminent, signaling caution against initiating aggressive new breakout long positions ahead of the Fed.
